fields.climate: varies from tropical along coast to temperate in highlands
fields.terrain: plains along coast; central plateau; highlands in north, south
fields.hazards: flooding on the central plateau during the rainy season; drought; volcanism: limited volcanic activity; Ol Doinyo Lengai (2,962 m) has emitted lava in recent years; other historically active volcanoes include Kieyo and Meru
fields.resources: hydropower, tin, phosphates, iron ore, coal, diamonds, gemstones (including tanzanite, found only in Tanzania), gold, natural gas, nickel
fields.farm: maize, cassava, sweet potatoes, bananas, milk, sugarcane, rice, vegetables, beans, sunflower seeds
fields.exports: gold, refined petroleum, dried legumes, refined copper, coal
fields.industries: agricultural processing (sugar, beer, cigarettes, sisal twine); mining (diamonds, gold, and iron), salt, soda ash; cement, oil refining, shoes, apparel, wood products, fertilizer
fields.languages: Kiswahili or Swahili (official), Kiunguja (name for Swahili in Zanzibar), English (official, primary language of commerce, administration, and higher education), Arabic, many local languages
fields.religions: Christian 63.1%, Muslim 34.1%, folk religion 1.1%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, other <1%, unspecified 1.6%

independence.event: Tanganyika united with Zanzibar to form the United Republic of…

fields.legal: English common law; judicial review of legislative acts limited to matters of interpretation
fields.military: generally 18-25 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women, but may go up to 35 years of age depending on education levels and for medical specialists; no conscription
